answer_4.quote: We conduct A/B testing (or pairwise comparison) to compare generations from two models. ... We instruct them by defining a good text paragraph as being: • Fluent ... • Coherent ... • Informative ... • Sensical.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose the better continuation based on fluency, coherence, informativeness, and sensicality, providing justifications.
